description: Ordered Minecraft feature inventory split into core, content, and utility. Each entry lists the primary client/server owners so sequencing stays aligned.

core.name: Chunk streaming & residency
core.notes: Stream chunks via EnhancedMinecraft protobuf (load/unload, view distance) using map-control profile for limits.

core.name: Authoritative player state sync
core.notes: Movement, rotation, and action sequencing (request/response) with rollback-safe packet ordering.

core.name: Block placement/break
core.notes: Data-driven block IDs/materials; queued sync broadcast for edits; honors container protection.

core.name: Inventory & crafting pipeline
core.notes: Hotbar + survival inventory with recipe JSON, stack rules, and protobuf container diffs.

core.name: Worldgen parity (terrain/cave/river/lake)
core.notes: Shared map-control profile, hydrology gradients, riparian buffers, and ceiling/seam sealing for caves.

core.name: Protocol registry & handler validation
core.notes: Google.Protobuf bindings validated at bootstrap; registry hash aligns with generated DTOs.

content.name: Biome + weather loop
content.notes: Data-driven biome palette, time/weather protobuf updates, sky/lighting binding.

content.name: Ores & structures
content.notes: Ore JSON ranges, dungeon/tree toggles, regional main caves and wetlands-aware placement.

content.name: Mob spawning and AI hooks
content.notes: Spawn tables from JSON, combat + pathing hooks, synced entity spawn/update/despawn messages.

content.name: Redstone/FX and audio glue
content.notes: ParticleEffect/SoundEffect protobuf usage, timing offsets, and culling rules.

util.name: JSON config sync
util.notes: Environment/config values managed via JSON (world, map-control, server-config) with hash verification.

util.name: Protobuf generation/verification
util.notes: Uses protoc C# output; ProtocolValidator + ProtocolStandardization enforce Google.Protobuf pipeline.

util.name: Telemetry, metrics, logging
util.notes: Room/session metrics, worldgen timings, packet health counters surfaced in server status response.

util.name: Self-test and CI hooks
util.notes: Smoke test for chunk/packet loopback plus targeted worldgen diffing against map-control JSON.
